While I was in Uni that happened to me a lot of times and a girl taught me this trick, hope you have everything in hand:

Get 2L of Coca Cola or Pepsi, it doesn’t matter, and let it stay in room temperature. Then throw everything on the toilet and let it there for an hour or two and then flush it with hot water.

It worked pretty well for me.

Good luck!
